reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to how music transitions work in Provincia. Instead of abrupt cuts, our new system uses a smooth crossfade for day, night, title, and combat music. This means a more immersive experience as you build your colony. Check out the full details on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
